message:
LLM cost per traced pipeline stage (propose or narrated discovery) moved above $0.40 over the last day — ~2.5x the measured baseline ($0.151 per mapping proposal, claude-opus-5-5, measured 2026-10-26). A payload growth, a model change, or retry looping shows up here before it shows up on the bill. Evals and probe spans are excluded by service, same as the fleet guardrail.

ml_obs.span.llm.total.cost is nanodollars (RC1-405), hence the /1e9.

RC1-548. @webhook-incident-summarizer
